overview_description.description: Y Combinator invests a standard amount of capital in exchange for equity and through uncapped safe agreements. Participants engage in a three-month intensive cycle that focuses on product development and preparations for fundraising. The firm offers access to a private networking platform for knowledge sharing and hosts events featuring speakers from various sectors. This program culminates in a presentation event where founders showcase their businesses to a curated group of investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Y Combinator provides a startup accelerator program and investment capital for early-stage companies across various industries.

product.name: Startup Accelerator Program
product.description: A program that provides early-stage startups with mentorship, funding, and resources to develop their business ideas and improve their chances of success.

product.name: YC Partner Mentorship
product.description: Dedicated mentorship from experienced partners who guide startups through application, interviews, and growth phases via in-person, email, and Slack communication.

product.name: YC Investor Database
product.description: A database providing profiles and reviews of over 50,000 startup investors to help founders identify and connect with potential funding sources.

product.name: Bookface Private Social Network
product.description: A private social network exclusive to YC founders for community interaction, advice sharing, and networking with alumni and potential customers.

product.name: Exclusive Software Deals
product.description: Access to over 1,000 software deals offering free credits or discounts on services like hosting, banking, and cap table management for YC startups.

product.name: YC Written Advice and Documentation
product.description: Extensive documentation covering common startup topics like fundraising, go-to-market strategies, sales, product-market fit, mental health, and hiring.
